Yes, `Path` exposes `move_into` in this snapshot, and it was added in Python 3.14.

`library/pathlib.rst` documents `Path.move_into(target_dir)`. It moves a file or directory tree into an existing directory and returns a new `Path` pointing to the moved path. The same entry carries `.. versionadded:: 3.14`.

